item.title: Tuks FM Shines at International Student Broadcast Championships and Telkom Radio Awards - TUKS FM
item.description: Tuks FM, the University of Pretoria’s student radio station, continues to solidify its reputation as of the leaders in the student and community broadcasting space, celebrating an exceptional performance at the International Student Broadcasting Championship (ISBC) and the Telkom Radio Awards.

item.title: Tuks FM Talent Shines During Youth Month Media Takeover - TUKS FM
item.description: June marked a proud chapter for Tuks FM as several of its student volunteers showcased their talents across leading South African media platforms during Youth Month. In true celebration of the voices and potential of young people, Tuks FM’s presence extended far beyond its usual airwaves.

item.title: Tuks FM Celebrates 45 Years Of Excellence With The Launch Of #TuksFM45 Campaign - TUKS FM
item.description: Tuks FM, the University of Pretoria's iconic campus radio station, officially launched its #TuksFM45 campaign today, marking 45 years of broadcasting, innovation, and community building. The campaign honours the station's remarkable legacy and outlines a bold vision for the future.

item.title: Tuks FM Empowers the Next Generation of Broadcasters at Bi-annual Training Day - TUKS FM
item.description: At Tuks FM, we’re passionate about shaping the next generation of broadcasters. Our Bi-annual Training Day, held on 27 September 2025, brought together industry experts, alumni, and our dedicated volunteers for a day of learning, inspiration, and connection.
